entities.summary: Emma Steinbakken is a Norwegian singer from Jessheim. She has released the songs "Not Gonna Cry" (2019) and "Without You". She performed on Swedish and Norwegian television as a guest on Fredrik Skavlan's talk show Skavlan in 2019. Emma Steinbakken was a composers & musicians from Jessheim (b. 2003-03-10, Jessheim).
